tool_plan.objective: Generate representative Chromium web-cache activity and preserve the Chrome cache data that ChromeCacheView can read, inspect, export, and extract.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Launch Chromium with a profile in which cache artifacts can be generated.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Create document and network-resource cache entries through distinct page loads.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observe visible links, controls, and finite options before exercising cache-relevant page behavior.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Submit realistic search input that can produce distinct cached response content.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Exercise visible page links or controls that load additional cached resources.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Commit an observed control when a specific visible interaction is needed.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Vary observed finite page parameters that may produce different cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveal lazy-loaded content and its associated network resources.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserve a visible representation of content associated with generated cache activity.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Close the browser after activity to flush pending cache data to the profile.

completion.detail: Complete only after Chromium has been closed to flush cache state and chromium.cache.cache_data is present in the browser profile.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium using the test profile. Use browser.goto with relevant run-provided runtime resources when available, selecting pages that naturally load documents and embedded resources. On each page, use browser.get_clickables to observe currently visible links, controls, and finite options. Enter realistic visible search or filter text with browser.smart_type where an observed input supports it, then use browser.smart_click or browser.click on observed controls or links to load additional content. Use browser.select_option only for visible finite choices that vary returned page content. Scroll through dynamically populated or media-rich visible content; after each bounded reveal, re-run browser.get_clickables and interact with newly visible relevant controls when appropriate. Capture browser.screenshot for representative rendered content associated with the activity. Visit a few distinct runtime-provided pages or contexts, then browser.close to flush the generated document, image, script, stylesheet, media, and response cache entries into chromium.cache.cache_data. Reason guidance: Write context-specific reasons describing the current page and cache-producing effect
